status: Measured September 12, 2026: Fluree v4.2.1, 850/850 queries completed, no errors or timeouts.

benchmark.name: Wikidata Graph Pattern Benchmark (WGPB)
benchmark.description: 850 basic graph pattern queries: 17 join shapes x 50 predicate instantiations. SELECT * ... LIMIT 1000 over Wikidata predicates; see the exact queries and archived hashes.
benchmark.source: Hogan, Riveros, Rojas, Soto: 'A Worst-Case Optimal Join Algorithm for SPARQL' (ISWC 2019); query set Zenodo 4035223

families.J3/J4: object-object joins on a shared variable (3/4 triple patterns)
families.S2: bipartite square: two subjects sharing two objects
families.S4: converging square: two paths meeting at both ends
families.T2/T3/T4: subject out-stars: 2/3/4 patterns sharing a subject
families.TI2/TI3/TI4: object in-stars: 2/3/4 patterns sharing an object

dataset.name: Wikidata all-dump
dataset.description: Full Wikidata RDF dump (latest-all.nt.gz), all statements
dataset.version: snapshot dated 2026-06-04; pinned in S3 as wikidata-all/all-2026-06-04.nt.gz

engine.name: Fluree
engine.import: Retained database imported September 8, 2026; reused without reimport or rechunking. Import timing is not a v4.2.1 measurement.
engine.server: HTTP SPARQL endpoint on loopback, WARN logging, FLUREE_CACHE_MAX_MB=88311

hardware.cpu: AMD EPYC 9R14, one thread per core

methodology.notes: Sequential queries in filename order; startup prime and TI3-40 JSON probe precede the suite. One warmup and three measured HTTP requests per query; curl time_total includes transfer. No cache clearing. One full-suite pass; no concurrency or cold-cache claim.
methodology.query_correction: J4-38: LIMIT 1000 placed after the closing WHERE brace; triple patterns and predicates unchanged.
